snippet.title: Dangerous Street for the Atari 8-bit family
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

Dangerous Street is a side-scrolling action game, in which you have to dodge, or shoot, different vehicles and balls.


What I think:

Ah, what's better on Christmas than shooting balls (lol)?

In all seriousness, this game is not very fun to play and extremely slow.

Also vehicles can kill you even if you are beneath, or above them.

Same counts for the balls.

Despite that, it is still a playable game....just not a good one.
